# Eventbrite UK
> Eventbrite UK is an event discovery, ticketing, and event management platform for finding, creating, promoting, and selling tickets to live and online events.

Eventbrite helps attendees discover local things to do and gives organisers tools for ticketing, marketing, payments, and event operations across many event types and industries.

## Core Platform
- [Eventbrite Home](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/): Main UK homepage for discovering events and accessing organiser tools.
- [Find Events](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/d/local/events/): Browse local events and things to do by location and category.
- [Find My Tickets](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/signin/signup?referrer=%2Fmytickets): Sign in to access purchased tickets and upcoming events.
- [Sign In](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/signin/): Account access for attendees and event organisers.
- [Create an Event](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/organizer/overview/): Starting point for organisers to set up and manage events.
- [Organiser Overview](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/organizer/overview/): Overview of Eventbrite tools for publishing, selling, and managing events.

## Event Discovery
- [Local Events](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/d/local/events/): Discover nearby events, activities, and experiences happening locally.
- [Music Events](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/d/united-kingdom--london/music--events/): Browse concerts, gigs, and music-related events.
- [Food & Drink Events](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/d/united-kingdom--london/food-and-drink--events/): Find tastings, dining events, and food-focused experiences.
- [Business Events](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/d/united-kingdom--london/business--events/): Explore conferences, networking, and professional events.
- [Arts Events](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/d/united-kingdom--london/arts--events/): Discover exhibitions, performances, and creative events.
- [Online Events](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/d/online/all-events/): Find virtual events, webinars, and online classes.

## Ticketing & Selling
- [Event Ticketing](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/sell-tickets/): Overview of Eventbrite ticketing tools for selling event tickets online.
- [Payments](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/event-payment/): Information about payment processing and getting paid for events.
- [Online Events Platform](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/virtual-events-platform/): Tools for hosting and monetising virtual events.
- [Eventbrite for Business](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/eventbrite-for-business/): Solutions for companies running internal or customer-facing events.
- [Conference Planning](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/conference-planning/): Ticketing and management tools tailored for conferences.
- [Festival Solutions](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/festival-solutions/): Eventbrite capabilities for festivals, fairs, and large-scale events.

## Marketing & Promotion
- [Event Marketing Platform](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/event-marketing-platform/): Marketing tools for promoting events and increasing registrations.
- [Eventbrite Ads](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/eventbrite-ads/): Paid promotion options to help organisers reach more attendees.
- [Sell More Tickets](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/sell-tickets/): Ticket sales features focused on conversion and attendee acquisition.
- [Virtual Event Promotion](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/virtual-events-platform/): Promotion and registration tools for online events.
- [Business Event Marketing](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/eventbrite-for-business/): Promotion workflows for corporate and branded events.

## Industry Solutions
- [Music](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/music/): Ticketing and promotion tools for music events and venues.
- [Food & Beverage](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/food-drink-event-ticketing/): Solutions for tastings, pop-ups, and food-focused events.
- [Performing Arts](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/performing-arts/): Event management tools for theatres, performances, and arts organisations.
- [Charity & Causes](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/npo/): Features for nonprofits, fundraisers, and mission-driven events.
- [Retail](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/host-retail-events/): Tools for in-store events, launches, and retail experiences.
- [Concerts](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/music-venues/): Solutions for concert promoters, venues, and live music organisers.
- [Classes & Workshops](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/create-a-workshop/): Support for recurring classes, workshops, and educational events.
- [Festivals & Fairs](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/festival-solutions/): Platform capabilities for multi-day and high-volume events.

## Event Types
- [Conferences](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/conference-planning/): Planning and ticketing tools for conferences and professional gatherings.
- [Corporate Events](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/eventbrite-for-business/): Solutions for team events, customer events, and company programs.
- [Online Events](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/virtual-events-platform/): Hosting, registration, and engagement tools for virtual events.
- [Workshops](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/create-a-workshop/): Features for hands-on learning sessions and instructional events.
- [Concerts & Live Music](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/music-venues/): Ticketing workflows for live performances and venue events.
- [Festivals](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/festival-solutions/): Support for large, multi-session, and outdoor event formats.

## Attendee Account & Access
- [My Tickets](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/signin/signup?referrer=%2Fmytickets): Access ticket orders, registrations, and saved event details.
- [Account Sign In](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/signin/): Log in to manage bookings, organiser settings, and account preferences.
- [Browse Events](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/d/local/events/): Search for events by location, interest, and format.
- [Online Event Discovery](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/d/online/all-events/): Explore virtual events available from anywhere.
- [Eventbrite Homepage](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/): Start discovering events or creating a new event.

## Organiser Resources
- [Organiser Overview](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/organizer/overview/): Central hub for organisers using Eventbrite event management tools.

- [Event Payments](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/event-payment/): Review payment and payout capabilities for organisers.
- [Marketing Platform](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/event-marketing-platform/): Understand promotion features for driving attendance.
- [Ads for Events](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/eventbrite-ads/): Reach broader audiences with Eventbrite advertising options.
- [Business Solutions](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/l/eventbrite-for-business/): Explore organiser tools for business and enterprise event programs.
